about: Every contest and file block of D2's files (data/governor, data/house, data/senate) that changed when D2's governor build was rerun with the governors' counts of pipeline/governor_counts.py, against b285fbe (main at 72d1d60 with the first part of this step's code; its data are main's): Connecticut's and New York's 2018 governors at every party line and Indiana's 2024 at the archive's certified count (the orchestrator, 2026-11-13 04:44: 'CT and NY 2018 governors: sum every line ... List the moves'; 'IN 2024 governor: the certified count wins ... list the move'); West Virginia's 2012 at the Secretary of State's official count and Utah's 2008 at the Lieutenant Governor's workbook, which Algara and Amlani's county returns agree with (05:26: 'take it and list the move'; 05:15 (3), the two-witness rule); Missouri's 2008, 2012 and 2016 and Maine's 2010, a note each, no count moved (05:26); Missouri's records before 2006 and 2008's last race, the words of chambers.AA_INCOMPLETE as measured; and Hawaii 2018's n at the two leaders' votes less one. The rest follow through the fits: each later race's last-race input (Connecticut and New York 2022, West Virginia 2016, Utah's 2010 special), the model's calibration, and the House's and Senate's near-tie factors, which the governors' back-test shares (each within 0.003%). data/local/REPORT.md section 35. The run's own stamps (a commit, a read time) are left out; files whose only change was a stamp were restored. 2024-house-ME-02's one change is its control note, as the code on main already writes it (the orchestrator, 04:44: 'ME-02 2024: agreed as built'). Written by worker D3.
